Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 15)
Topic: Planets (Grah) — Why Astrology Only Gets You 30%, and Who Really Contr ols Your Direction

Sour ce: Bhaiya's satsang session (video transcript, ~63 min), Mool T attva series. Covers the scientific framing of planetary influence, why r emedies have a har d ceiling, the "four people" concept that actually determines destiny's outcome, and a personal testimony on changing one's own kundli thr ough var dan (boon). Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version.
1. PLANETS ARE DEVTAS — AND DEVTAS CANNOT BE STOPPED

Grah (planets) genuinely affect every person — this is simply true, whatever skeptics claim. Planets are treated as devtas in this framework, and "no one can stop a devta." Humans exist on earth; bhoot-pret exist in the layer between devtas and humans. When a devta actively wills something (like holding up a "shield"), negativity cannot get thr ough even if it wants to — but the moment a devta's attention shifts elsewhere, negativity finds its opening. This sets up the session's central theme: planetary influence is real, but it operates alongside — and is often overridden by — other forces in the same space.
2. THE SCIENTIFIC FRAMING — RELATIVE MOTION OF EARTH WITH OTHER PLANETS

Technically , planetary ef fect is described as "the relative motion of Earth with differ ent planets." The car analogy: imagine a car moving at a constant high speed (say , 100), with a front passenger who has a window they can open or close, and two back-seat passengers whose section has no roof at all. As weather and surroundings change — good weather , rain, a foul-smelling area — the front passenger can adjust their window and barely notice. The back-seat passengers with no r oof cannot escape any of it — they simply take the hit of whatever passes, because ther e is no shield available to them at all. Earth itself is this same moving "car" — travelling at a genuinely fast, constant speed around the sun. Whatever surrounding "environment" (nearby planetary configuration) Earth passes through will af fect everyone aboard — but your own "seating position" (your protective cir cumstances) determines how much of that effect actually r eaches you , and how much you can mitigate versus simply endure.
3. WHY GRAH AFFECTS EVERY ELEMENT DIFFERENTLY

Planetary movement affects every tattva/element differ ently — metal, iron, aluminum, silicon, and water each interact with planetary movement in their own distinct way . No one is exempt fr om this effect on some level — you will not simply "escape" it.

Ancient sages recognized this pattern and developed it into what became astro-science (jyotish): observing that when a child is born, extremely subtle planetary "tarangein" (waves) settle on them, each planet's own wave contributing its own attraction/repulsion depending on the child's specific planetary positions. Our sants and mahatmas went further , mapping specific planets to specific body parts and traits — a bright/glowing face and good teeth linked to a strong Surya (Sun), for example — connecting every body part to a governing planet.
4. WHY REMEDIES ONLY WORK UP TO ~30%

Given how deeply planets are woven into every part of a person, it's natural that people chase planetary remedies: "your Mangal is weak, do Hanuman Ji's sadhna"; "your Chandra is weak, of fer milk to Bholenath and do this or that." These remedies genuinely have SOME effect — but Bhaiya states plainly , in writing: no planetary r emedy will ever move the needle mor e than about 30%, with the most extreme, exceptional cases reaching perhaps 35%. A direct challenge to r eflect on: look honestly across your own life at every planetary remedy you've ever done — you will find the actual benefit never exceeded this ceiling. This is of fered as a testable, personal claim, not an abstract one. Recognizing this ceiling, sants historically sought a dif ferent route entirely — working through tarangein (subtle waves)/ener gy-building methods rather than only through conventional remedies (small fixes like wearing red, applying a specific tilak, or drinking alcohol to "pacify Shani") — all of which are described as capping out at roughly the same ~30% ceiling.
5. THE REAL COMPOUNDING PROBLEM — DASHA PLUS ATTACHED NEGATIVITY/PITRU

A planetary dasha (period) is temporary — like changing weather while your car keeps moving, you will eventually pass through it, because you ar e continuously in motion. A bad dasha, on its own, does end. The real trap: negativity or a pitru can attach itself during that dasha window — and this attachment does NOT automatically leave just because the dasha itself ends. The person then continues to be blocked from receiving the benefits of even a subsequently favorable planetary period, because the attached negativity/pitru remains and keeps interfering, regardless of what the planets themselves are now doing.
6. WHY "RAJ YOG" PREDICTIONS OFTEN DON'T MATERIALIZE

Many people are told they carry a "gajraj yog" or "raj yog" in their kundli — destined for a great career , wealth, or partner . Bhaiya states that r oughly 95 out of 100 such people never see any r eal benefit fr om this pr edicted yog ("thenga bhi nahi mila") — and confusingly , many of these same people are also told they carry doshas, with everything else ("great household, great in-laws, great spouse") promised as well, none of which necessarily arrives either . This appar ent contradiction (pr edicted very well, turned out very differ ently) points to something intervening between the "written" destiny and the actual lived outcome — which is precisely what the next section addresses.
7. WHAT AN ASTROLOGER CAN ACTUALLY TELL YOU — THE GOOGLE MAPS ANALOGY

A good astr ologer (jyotishi) functions like someone r eading your intended route on Google Maps. If your route runs from Delhi to Mumbai via a specific path (through Rohtak, Bahadur garh, then a particular area, then a checkpoint near Gurugram), a good guide can tell you what you're likely to encounter along THAT route — local dif ficulties in one stretch, extra scrutiny at a checkpoint further on.

If your route/track leads toward a symbolically "good" destination (e.g., Mumbai, wher e you might meet someone like Shah Rukh Khan), the guide will excitedly pr edict "raj yog" for you — without actually knowing WHAT you'll be doing once you arrive (you might simply be washing dishes there). Astrology describes the type of destination/r oute you'r e fated to encounter — not the substantive quality of what you experience once you get ther e.
8. DESTINY VS. DIRECTION — WHAT CAN AND CANNOT BE CHANGED

Destiny is r eal in a specific, limited sense: it fixes the general ROUTE — that you WILL pass thr ough certain places/phases in your life. This part can be stated with certainty . What destiny does NOT determine: whether you get diverted, misled, delayed, or even fully "hijacked" away fr om your intended destination. If your route happens to pass through a rougher area to reach Mumbai, and your car is forced to slow down or stop exactly there, that is pr ecisely when interfer ence gets seated — and once seated, it can deliberately keep misdirecting you so you never actually reach your true destined outcome, potentially derailing your life course entirely . This is what actually determines outcome and timing: not fixed destiny alone, but who is riding along with you.
9. THE "FOUR PEOPLE" — WHO REALLY CONTROLS YOUR DIRECTION

Beyond the physically visible people in your life, there ar e always "four people" (char log) riding along with you astrally — invisible companions who genuinely determine what happens on your journey: Pitrus — deceased family members (an uncle, aunt, or similar relative) who attach themselves to a descendant. Outside negativity that attaches itself. A negativity deliberately SENT through targeted tantrik kriya by someone who bears personal enmity or anger toward you (performed, for example, from a cremation ground). Whatever else gets drawn in through the same general category of attachment. These "four" can r eplace or dominate your true direction pr ecisely at the moments your journey is most vulnerable — and once seated, they will keep misdirecting you, potentially preventing you from ever reaching your true destined outcome (in the analogy , a full "hijack" of the journey). (Clarifying note: "lok" — a metaphysical r ealm/world — is a differ ent concept and should not be confused with these four astral "people"/companions.)
10. THE FIRST PRIORITY — FIXING YOUR "FOUR PEOPLE"

If your "four people" ar e good/positive, even genuinely turbulent planetary weather becomes just a bump you pass through cheerfully — not a r eal crisis. This is illustrated with a live example: a mother worried about her 14-year -old son's dif ficult behavior under an active Rahu dosha (running until age 19) is advised to focus on "changing her four people" rather than only chasing a fix for the planetary dosha itself. The first priority for anyone wanting to change their destiny: build a str ong enough connection in the astral world that 2–3 genuine tattvas/entities ar e with you 24/7, actively giving you corr ect direction. This astral-world connection is described as mattering far more than anything achievable purely at the physical level. The guarantee given: with r eal astral-world backing, harmful people simply won't stick ar ound long-term in your physical life — and if they do appear , they won't last. People who intend you harm will end up benefiting you instead, and will leave right befor e they'r e able to cause damage. This is described as the actual power of "fixing your four people."
1 1. HOW TO ACTUALLY CHANGE YOUR OWN FATE — THE SIMPLE VERSION

The full process, stripped down to its essentials: (1) understand which "track" you'r e currently on and wher e it leads; (2) get a genuine guide who can r edirect you; (3) act on that r edirection — take the turn, r efuel, and go. This, according
to this teaching, is literally what "changing your fate" means — not a mystical process, however many volumes of scripture have been written trying to explain it.
12. HOW ANCIENT SANTS BROKE THEIR OWN CYCLE

Historically , sants and rishis who understood this dynamic broke their own cycle by taking decisive PHYSICAL action FIRST — leaving home (since staying amid family created ongoing conflict/klesh), changing the clothes they wore, the people they associated with, the food they ate, and where they slept — purely to break the established pattern and thereby change their "four people." Only after this physical-level change did they pr ogr ess to working at the astral level. (Bhaiya notes many contemporary sants take the reverse path — moving from an astral experience toward physical lifestyle change — but historically , physical action came first.)
13. THE "LOOP" (CYCLE) — RECOGNIZING YOU'RE STUCK

Many people live inside a repeating personal cycle: "I start, I fail. I start, I fail." The same type of people keep showing up, the same mistakes r ecur, with only small surface variations. Recognizing that you'r e inside such a loop is itself a meaningful form of self-awar eness — many people go their whole lives without ever noticing this pattern in themselves. People in their 20s may just be starting to notice it; people in their 30s tend to recognize it clearly; and older people often know EXACTL Y what a given choice or word will trigger — and still do it anyway , because the underlying "four people"/circumstances haven't changed, so the same automatic pattern fires again regardless of foreknowledge. If you r ecognize this r epeating loop in your own life, take it as a genuine signal that r eal planetary/negativity influence has a str ong, consistent grip on you — and that both the cycle itself and your "four people" need to change.
14. THE FASTER ROUTE — VARDAN (BOON) FROM A DEVTA

The classical yogic path (dhyana, dharana, samadhi, working toward direct atma-tattva realization) is one legitimate way to gain the clarity/direction needed to change one's fate. The faster , alternative r oute for an ordinary practitioner: appr oach a guide/Guru who alr eady has this mastery , and seek a genuine vardan (boon) fr om a devta thr ough them. Once a genuine vardan is r eceived fr om any devta, the "line" of a person's destiny actually changes. This directly contradicts the common belief that "vardan doesn't happen in Kali Yuga" — this teaching insists it still happens, specifically through this guided, devotional route (as opposed to the harder , solo yogic path). A vardan is not quick — it is explicitly NOT achievable in just six months. Genuine change requires real, sustained bhaav (devotion) and tap (sustained ef fort/austerity) over meaningful time. A striking additional claim: once a person r eceives a genuine vardan, their own atma tattva becomes capable of generating MUL TIPLE grah-like influences of its own. This is of fered as the explanation for why realized sant-mahatmas seem to transcend planetary influence rather than merely being protected from it — they don't just escape being controlled by external planets; they become sources of planetary-strength influence themselves, which can then work for others as well as for themselves.
15. BHAIY A'S PERSONAL TESTIMONY

Five years earlier (during his graduation's second year), Bhaiya suf fered chronic body pain alongside a persistently weak Mangal (Mars), Kaal Sarp Dosh, an additional Mangal dosha, and a consistently poor Chandra (Moon) — leading multiple pandits to warn him of a genuinely hard life, even predicting an early or violent death. He gr ew tired of hearing these repeated dir e predictions.

He once tested a visiting pandit with a hypothetical: "what if Mangal were positioned where Guru (Jupiter) should be in my chart?" The pandit answered: "raj yog." Bhaiya decided this was exactly the outcome to pursue — through intense, isolated devotion to Hanuman Ji Maharaj, chanting continuously and praying specifically for Hanuman Ji to occupy that "Guru" role in his life. His conclusion: devtas genuinely do grant boons, but strictly in pr oportion to r eal bhaav and sustained tap — and sometimes r eal change r equires deliberately br eaking your own life's established cycle. A genuine vardan takes real time to manifest, not months.
16. A DEVOTEE'S TESTIMONY (SHARED LIVE IN THE SESSION)

A sangat member described her own long-standing Kaal Sarp Dosh, Mangalik Dosh, and "Mool" nakshatra complications — including an earlier symbolic marriage to Shaligram Ji (a common remedial ritual for mangalik doshas) performed before her real marriage, hoping conditions would improve afterward. They did not. Her own children initially discouraged her Hanuman Ji devotion ("girls don't do that"), leading her to quietly step back from it for a time. She had also invested heavily in remedies (multiple kumbh vivahs, multiple bal-Ganesh havans) — enough that one astrologer , alarmed by the sheer number of doshas in her chart, reportedly told her he didn't know how she was even still alive. She had also suffer ed lifelong chr onic stomach issues and would go half-numb in her body while trying to sit and pray — both of which r esolved as her devotion (thr ough Ashaeiynn) pr ogr essed, to the point she can now eat freely without the old digestive trouble.
17. WHY MIDDLE-CLASS PEOPLE SPECIFICALLY STRUGGLE WITH THIS PATH

Bhaiya observes that a middle-class or upper-middle-class person often cannot show or practice devotion as openly or intensely as they might wish — social reputation ("izzat"), financial pressure, and family disapproval all constrain them in ways that don't apply as strongly either below or above that bracket (those below have comparatively less scrutiny/less to lose reputationally; those above face little practical restriction and typically don't need this kind of structural help in the first place). This preoccupation with "izzat" specifically makes middle-class households mor e exposed to petty interfer ence over reputation-r elated trivialities (the example given: a jealous neighbor performing a minor "kriya" simply because their buf falo produced more milk). Ashaeiynn's stated mission is specifically to open a path for exactly this gr oup — people who cannot leave home for extended sadhana or pilgrimage, cannot practice devotion openly without family friction, and lack access to specialized guidance that would otherwise require years at a dedicated ashram. The aim is to make it possible to open one's own drishti, connect with Hanuman Ji Maharaj's shakti, and receive a genuine vardan while remaining at home, without needing to abandon ordinary life circumstances.
18. THE PRACTICAL COMMITMENT, AND WHY SELF-LEARNING MATTERS

A weekly practice is described: every Sunday , from 12:00 to 4:00 PM, sangat members are invited to sit for as long as they're able (even 2–3 hours) while mentors do focused jaap specifically for their benefit. The explicit expectation alongside this: each person must also learn for themselves — the goal being that no fraudulent tantrik or "nautankibaaz" (charlatan) can ever deceive them again, because they will have enough real knowledge to recognize genuine practice versus fakery on their own. The warning given for not building this competence: without it, a person (and potentially their descendants) risks being exploited indefinitely by opportunistic frauds — even citing the risk of an unscrupulous local tantrik claiming and exploiting a vulnerable soul after death for its own gain.
19. WHY SOME QUESTIONS ARE DELIBERATELY LEFT UNANSWERED

When asked directly about a specific rumored practice/siddhi referred to as "karma pishachini," Bhaiya explicitly declined to comment — stating plainly that Ashaeiynn deliberately avoids controversy or commentary about other specific practitioners or rumored practices, and deferring with: "once your own drishti opens, you can see for yourself." This models a deliberate institutional restraint around hearsay and unverified claims about third parties.
